```typescript
// Clone stamp types and operations

export interface CloneSource {
  readonly documentX: number;
  readonly documentY: number;
}

export interface CloneStampOptions {
  readonly size: number;
  readonly hardness: number;
  readonly opacity: number;
}

function validateCloneStampOptions(options: CloneStampOptions): void {
  assertFinite(options.size, 'Clone brush size');
  if (options.size <= 0) throw new RangeError('Clone brush size must be greater than 0');
  assertUnit(options.hardness, 'Clone brush hardness');
  assertUnit(options.opacity, 'Clone brush opacity');
}

export function sampleCloneSource(
  sourceStore: TiledPixelStore,
  sourceWorld: LayerTransform,
  sourceX: number,
  sourceY: number,
): [number, number, number, number] {
  validateTransform(sourceWorld);
  const inverse = invertTransform(sourceWorld);
  const local = transformPoint(inverse, sourceX, sourceY);
  const sampleX = clampIndex(local.x, sourceStore.width);
  const sampleY = clampIndex(local.y, sourceStore.height);
  const tile = sourceStore.getTile(
    Math.floor(sampleX / sourceStore.tileSize),
    Math.floor(sampleY / sourceStore.tileSize),
  );
  if (tile === null) return [0, 0, 0, 0];
  const offset = (sampleY - tile.y) * tile.width + sampleX - tile.x;
  return [
    tile.pixels[offset * 4] ?? 0,
    tile.pixels[offset * 4 + 1] ?? 0,
    tile.pixels[offset * 4 + 2] ?? 0,
    tile.pixels[offset * 4 + 3] ?? 0,
  ];
}

export function paintCloneStroke(
  sourceStore: TiledPixelStore,
  sourceWorld: LayerTransform,
  destinationLayer: PixelLayer,
  cloneSource: CloneSource | null,
  points: readonly BrushPoint[],
  options: CloneStampOptions,
  aligned: boolean,
  selection?: SelectionMask | null,
  destinationWorld: LayerTransform = destinationLayer.transform,
): PixelPatch {
  validateLayer(destinationLayer);
  validateTransform(destinationWorld);
  validateSelection(selection);
  validateTransform(sourceWorld);
  
  if (cloneSource == null) {
    return emptyPatch();
  }
  
  validateCloneStampOptions(options);
  
  // Compute the source local position for validation
  const sourceInverse = invertTransform(sourceWorld);
  const sourceLocal = transformPoint(sourceInverse, cloneSource.documentX, cloneSource.documentY);
  assertFinite(sourceLocal.x, 'Clone source local x');
  assertFinite(sourceLocal.y, 'Clone source local y');
  
  const radius = options.size / 2;
  const destInverse = invertTransform(destinationWorld);
  const spacing = Math.max(0.25, radius * 0.5);
  
  // Build interpolated dabs
  const dabs: Array<{ x: number; y: number; pressure: number }> = [];
  const first = points[0];
  dabs.push({ x: first.x, y: first.y, pressure: first.pressure ?? 1 });
  for (let index = 1; index < points.length; index += 1) {
    const start = points[index - 1];
    const end = points[index];
    const distance = Math.hypot(end.x - start.x, end.y - start.y);
    const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(distance / spacing));
    for (let step = 1; step <= steps; step += 1) {
      const progress = step / steps;
      dabs.push({
        x: start.x + (end.x - start.x) * progress,
        y: start.y + (end.y - start.y) * progress,
        pressure: (start.pressure ?? 1) + ((end.pressure ?? 1) - (start.pressure ?? 1)) * progress,
      });
    }
  }
  
  // Compute destination working set (union of local dab bounds)
  let strokeBounds: Bounds | null = null;
  for (const dab of dabs) {
    strokeBounds = unionBounds(
      strokeBounds,
      localDabBounds(destinationWorld, destInverse, dab.x, dab.y, radius, destinationLayer.width, destinationLayer.height),
    );
  }
  if (strokeBounds === null || strokeBounds.right < strokeBounds.left) {
    return emptyPatch();
  }
  
  const regionLeft = strokeBounds.left;
  const regionTop = strokeBounds.top;
  const regionWidth = strokeBounds.right - strokeBounds.left + 1;
  const regionHeight = strokeBounds.bottom - strokeBounds.top + 1;
  const next = destinationLayer.pixelStore.read({
    x: regionLeft,
    y: regionTop,
    width: regionWidth,
    height: regionHeight,
  });
  
  const selectionRegion = readSelectionRegion(selection, dabs, radius);
  let changedBounds: Bounds | null = null;
  
  for (const dab of dabs) {
    const bounds = localDabBounds(
      destinationWorld,
      destInverse,
      dab.x,
      dab.y,
      radius,
      destinationLayer.width,
      destinationLayer.height,
    );
    const { left, top, right, bottom } = bounds;
    for (let y = top; y <= bottom; y += 1) {
      for (let x = left; x <= right; x += 1) {
        const documentPoint = transformPoint(destinationWorld, x, y);
        const falloff = dabCoverage(
          Math.hypot(documentPoint.x - dab.x, documentPoint.y - dab.y),
          radius,
          options.hardness,
        );
        const selected = selectionCoverage(
          selection,
          documentPoint.x,
          documentPoint.y,
          selectionRegion.buffer,
          selectionRegion.region,
        );
        const coverage = falloff * options.opacity * dab.pressure * selected;
        if (coverage <= 0) continue;
        
        // Compute source document point
        const sourceDocumentX = aligned
          ? documentPoint.x + (cloneSource.documentX - first.x)
          : cloneSource.documentX;
        const sourceDocumentY = aligned
          ? documentPoint.y + (cloneSource.documentY - first.y)
          : cloneSource.documentY;
        
        const sampled = sampleCloneSource(sourceStore, sourceWorld, sourceDocumentX, sourceDocumentY);
        const offset = ((y - regionTop) * regionWidth + (x - regionLeft)) * 4;
        const before = [
          next[offset],
          next[offset + 1],
          next[offset + 2],
          next[offset + 3],
        ];
        compositeSourceOver(next, offset, sampled, coverage);
        if (
          before[0] !== next[offset] ||
          before[1] !== next[offset + 1] ||
          before[2] !== next[offset + 2] ||
          before[3] !== next[offset + 3]
        ) {
          changedBounds = include(changedBounds, x, y);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  return makePatchFromRegion(regionLeft, regionTop, regionWidth, next, changedBounds);
}

export function paintCloneStrokePixelStore(
  sourceStore: TiledPixelStore,
  sourceWorld: LayerTransform,
  destinationLayer: PixelLayer,
  cloneSource: CloneSource | null,
  points: readonly BrushPoint[],
  options: CloneStampOptions,
  aligned: boolean,
  selection?: SelectionMask | null,
  destinationWorld: LayerTransform = destinationLayer.transform,
): TiledPixelStore {
  const patch = paintCloneStroke(
    sourceStore,
    sourceWorld,
    destinationLayer,
    cloneSource,
    points,
    options,
    aligned,
    selection,
    destinationWorld,
  );
  if (patch.width === 0) return destinationLayer.pixelStore;
  return destinationLayer.pixelStore.write({ ...patch, pixels: new Uint8ClampedArray(patch.pixels) }).store;
}
```

```ts
export interface CloneSource {
  readonly documentX: number;
  readonly documentY: number;
}

export interface CloneStampOptions {
  readonly size: number;
  readonly hardness: number;
  readonly opacity: number;
}

export function sampleCloneSource(
  sourceStore: TiledPixelStore,
  sourceWorld: LayerTransform,
  sourceX: number,
  sourceY: number,
): [number, number, number, number] {
  validateTransform(sourceWorld);
  assertFinite(sourceX, 'Clone source x');
  assertFinite(sourceY, 'Clone source y');
  const inverse = invertTransform(sourceWorld);
  const local = transformPoint(inverse, sourceX, sourceY);
  const sampleX = clampIndex(local.x, sourceStore.width);
  const sampleY = clampIndex(local.y, sourceStore.height);
  const tile = sourceStore.getTile(
    Math.floor(sampleX / sourceStore.tileSize),
    Math.floor(sampleY / sourceStore.tileSize),
  );
  if (tile === null) return [0, 0, 0, 0];
  const offset = ((sampleY - tile.y) * tile.width + sampleX - tile.x) * 4;
  return [
    tile.pixels[offset] ?? 0,
    tile.pixels[offset + 1] ?? 0,
    tile.pixels[offset + 2] ?? 0,
    tile.pixels[offset + 3] ?? 0,
  ];
}

export function paintCloneStroke(
  sourceStore: TiledPixelStore,
  sourceWorld: LayerTransform,
  destinationLayer: PixelLayer,
  cloneSource: CloneSource | null,
  points: readonly BrushPoint[],
  options: CloneStampOptions,
  aligned: boolean,
  selection?: SelectionMask | null,
  destinationWorld: LayerTransform = destinationLayer.transform,
): PixelPatch {
  validateLayer(destinationLayer);
  validateTransform(destinationWorld);
  validateSelection(selection);
  validateTransform(sourceWorld);
  if (cloneSource == null) return emptyPatch();
  const sourcePos = transformPoint(invertTransform(sourceWorld), cloneSource.documentX, cloneSource.documentY);
  assertFinite(sourcePos.x, 'Clone source local x');
  assertFinite(sourcePos.y, 'Clone source local y');
  assertFinite(options.size, 'Clone brush size');
  if (options.size <= 0) return emptyPatch();
  assertUnit(options.hardness, 'Clone brush hardness');
  assertUnit(options.opacity, 'Clone brush opacity');
  const radius = options.size / 2;
  const destInverse = invertTransform(destinationWorld);
  const spacing = Math.max(0.25, radius * 0.5);
  const dabs: Array<{ x: number; y: number; pressure: number }> = [];
  const first = points[0];
  dabs.push({ x: first.x, y: first.y, pressure: first.pressure ?? 1 });
  for (let index = 1; index < points.length; index++) {
    const start = points[index - 1];
    const end = points[index];
    const distance = Math.hypot(end.x - start.x, end.y - start.y);
    const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(distance / spacing));
    for (let step = 1; step <= steps; step++) {
      const progress = step / steps;
      dabs.push({
        x: start.x + (end.x - start.x) * progress,
        y: start.y + (end.y - start.y) * progress,
        pressure: (start.pressure ?? 1) + ((end.pressure ?? 1) - (start.pressure ?? 1)) * progress,
      });
    }
  }
  let strokeBounds: Bounds | null = null;
  for (const dab of dabs) {
    strokeBounds = unionBounds(
      strokeBounds,
      localDabBounds(destinationWorld, destInverse, dab.x, dab.y, radius, destinationLayer.width, destinationLayer.height),
    );
  }
  if (strokeBounds === null || strokeBounds.right < strokeBounds.left) return emptyPatch();
  const regionLeft = strokeBounds.left;
  const regionTop = strokeBounds.top;
  const regionWidth = strokeBounds.right - strokeBounds.left + 1;
  const regionHeight = strokeBounds.bottom - strokeBounds.top + 1;
  const next = destinationLayer.pixelStore.read({
    x: regionLeft,
    y: regionTop,
    width: regionWidth,
    height: regionHeight,
  });
  const selectionRegion = readSelectionRegion(selection, dabs, radius);
  let changedBounds: Bounds | null = null;
  for (const dab of dabs) {
    const bounds = localDabBounds(
      destinationWorld,
      destInverse,
      dab.x,
      dab.y,
      radius,
      destinationLayer.width,
      destinationLayer.height,
    );
    const { left, top, right, bottom } = bounds;
    for (let y = top; y <= bottom; y++) {
      for (let x = left; x <= right; x++) {
        const documentPoint = transformPoint(destinationWorld, x, y);
        const falloff = dabCoverage(
          Math.hypot(documentPoint.x - dab.x, documentPoint.y - dab.y),
          radius,
          options.hardness,
        );
        const selected = selectionCoverage(
          selection,
          documentPoint.x,
          documentPoint.y,
          selectionRegion.buffer,
          selectionRegion.region,
        );
        const coverage = falloff * options.opacity * dab.pressure * selected;
        if (coverage <= 0) continue;
        const sourceDocumentX = aligned
          ? documentPoint.x + (cloneSource.documentX - first.x)
          : cloneSource.documentX;
        const sourceDocumentY = aligned
          ? documentPoint.y + (cloneSource.documentY - first.y)
          : cloneSource.documentY;
        const sampled = sampleCloneSource(sourceStore, sourceWorld, sourceDocumentX, sourceDocumentY);
        const offset = ((y - regionTop) * regionWidth + (x - regionLeft)) * 4;
        const before = [next[offset], next[offset + 1], next[offset + 2], next[offset + 3]];
        compositeSourceOver(next, offset, sampled, coverage);
        if (
          before[0] !== next[offset] ||
          before[1] !== next[offset + 1] ||
          before[2] !== next[offset + 2] ||
          before[3] !== next[offset + 3]
        ) {
          changedBounds = include(changedBounds, x, y);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return makePatchFromRegion(regionLeft, regionTop, regionWidth, next, changedBounds);
}

export function paintCloneStrokePixelStore(
  sourceStore: TiledPixelStore,
  sourceWorld: LayerTransform,
  destinationLayer: PixelLayer,
  cloneSource: CloneSource | null,
  points: readonly BrushPoint[],
  options: CloneStampOptions,
  aligned: boolean,
  selection?: SelectionMask | null,
  destinationWorld: LayerTransform = destinationLayer.transform,
): TiledPixelStore {
  const patch = paintCloneStroke(sourceStore, sourceWorld, destinationLayer, cloneSource, points, options, aligned, selection, destinationWorld);
  if (patch.width === 0) return destinationLayer.pixelStore;
  return destinationLayer.pixelStore.write({ ...patch, pixels: new Uint8ClampedArray(patch.pixels) }).store;
}

```typescript
export function sampleCloneSource(
  sourceStore: TiledPixelStore,
  sourceWorld: LayerTransform,
  sourceX: number,
  sourceY: number,
): [number, number, number, number] {
  const inverse = invertTransform(sourceWorld);
  const local = transformPoint(inverse, sourceX, sourceY);
  const sampleX = clampIndex(local.x, sourceStore.width);
  const sampleY = clampIndex(local.y, sourceStore.height);
  const tile = sourceStore.getTile(
    Math.floor(sampleX / sourceStore.tileSize),
    Math.floor(sampleY / sourceStore.tileSize),
  );
  if (tile === null) return [0, 0, 0, 0];
  const offset = (sampleY - tile.y) * tile.width + sampleX - tile.x) * 4;
  return [
    tile.pixels[offset] ?? 0,
    tile.pixels[offset + 1] ?? 0,
    tile.pixels[offset + 2] ?? 0,
    tile.pixels[offset + 3] ?? 0,
  ];
}
```

export function paintCloneStrokePixelStore(

  points: readonly BrushPoint[],
  options: CloneStampOptions,
